title: Carson Benge Had a .498 OPS in May. He Finished With the First 20-20 Rookie Season in Mets History.
yt_title: Carson Benge: The Mets Rookie Who Went 20-20 in 2026

slides.label: The start
slides.text: The 23-year-old made the Mets' Opening Day roster, then posted a *.498 OPS* over his first month.

slides.label: The turn
slides.text: From May 3 on: an *.828 OPS* over his final *126 games*.

slides.label: The line
slides.text: *.282*, *20 homers*, *65 RBIs*, *22 steals*: the *first 20-20 rookie season* in Mets history.

slides.label: The arm
slides.text: *10 outfield assists*, most of any NL right fielder. *4.3 WAR*, a mark only Pete Alonso reached among Mets rookies.

slides.label: The vote
slides.text: Sal Stewart won NL Rookie of the Year with *20 of 30* first-place votes. Benge got *seven*.

question: Snub or fair call?
